products.title: Creste Di Gallo
products.descriptionHtml: Creste di Gallo is a traditional Italian pasta shape resembling a rooster’s crest, hence its name. Made with durum wheat flour, it results in a firm texture and a slightly nutty flavor, perfect for holding rich sauces. The ridges and unique shape allow it to capture more sauce, making it ideal for hearty dishes like ragù, pesto, or even creamy sauces.

products.title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil IGP Puglia - Intense 16.9 fl oz
products.descriptionHtml: From Apulia with love comes this bold and exciting Extra Virgin Olive Oil. Its intense flavor and aroma will remind you of freshly-cut grass, tannic white almonds, and earthy artichokes. This robust olive oil maintains the perfect balance between bitter and spicy. Try it with slow roasted meats, game meats, or hearty winter soups. Be creative and drizzle a little on a scoop of vanilla ice cream! This is a Nutraceutical Extra Virgin Olive Oil Sensory: Green fruity intense herbaceous with hints of white almond and artichoke Flavor: Fluid with persistent and balanced spicy and bitterness Features: - 16,9 Fl Oz / 500ml - PGI (Protected Geographical Indication) - Production Area: Central Puglia, Italy - Harvest Period: October/November - Cold-Extracted - Greaseproof Label

products.title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil IGP Sicilia - Delicate
products.descriptionHtml: Welcome to the beautiful island of Sicily! The slightly spicy flavor of our PGI Sicilian Extra-Virgin Olive Oil exudes the aromas of this well-known Italian island. With its delicate flavor of freshly picked tomatoes, fresh vegetables, artichokes, and bitter and spicy herbs, this olive oil is the perfect match for salmon carpaccio, pasta with tomato sauce, or grilled fish, and it’s delicious on its own as a bread dipper. Sensory: Fruity delicate with a hint of freshly picked tomatoes and fresh vegetables, artichoke and herbs Flavor: Pasty with persistent bitterness and spiciness, both balanced From Apulia with love comes this bold and exciting Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

products.title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil IGP Toscana - Medium
products.descriptionHtml: An amazingly fruity Extra Virgin Olive Oil with just a hint of artichoke, ripe fruit, and fresh tomato on the palate. From the hills of Val d’Orcia and the Tuscan Maremma, this olive oil is clean, fresh, and sweet up front and slightly bitter and spicy on the finish. It’s delightfully versatile, pairing well with hearty vegetables and pureed soups as well as fresh salads, meats and fish. This is also the perfect olive oil for vinaigrettes and sauces. It’s great for deep frying, too. Sensory: Medium fruity, clean olive, with herbaceous notes of artichoke and ripe fruit and, to a lesser extent, tomato. Flavor: Fresh and clean, it opens with a slight sweet sensation followed by a pleasant bitter and spicy charge of medium intensity, rich persistence in vegetal notes, dominated by the herbaceous sensation of artichoke.

products.title: Giusti Historical Trio Balsamic Vinegar Gift Set
products.descriptionHtml:
Each balsamic is created with the must of cooked grapes and aged wine vinegar and then aged to perfection in oak barrels with the addition of aged balsamic vinegar extracted from centuries-old casks.

The balsamic vinegars are named after the medals they earned at International Fairs in the 19th century.

1 Silver Medal, also known as Medaglia d’Argento, is aged in French oak barrels from the 1900s with the addition of aged balsamic vinegar from centuries-old casks. It is aromatic and enhances the flavors of dishes with its intensity.

2 Gold Medals, Il Classico, is versatile and nicely balanced between the sweet and sour, with overtones of mature fruits, licorice, and black pepper. It is aged in oak barrels, with the addition of aged balsamic vinegar from centuries-old casks.

3 Gold Medals, Riccardo Giusti, is created from sweet, sundried grapes which creates an aroma and flavor of plum jam and red fruits intertwined with hints of honey and vanilla.

MADE IN: MODENA, ITALY

products.descriptionHtml:
Elevate your culinary creations with our Sicilian Sea Salt. Perfect for meat and fish, this flavored sea salt boasts a blend of aromatic herbs and spices, including oregano, rosemary, thyme, dried lemon peel, and chili pepper. Whether you're dry rubbing before grilling or sautéing, or using it as a finishing touch, this salt will transform your dishes into gourmet delights. Discover the rich flavors of Sicily in every sprinkle!

Frantoi Cutrera is known for its high-quality extra virgin olive oil. The farm has been operating olive groves and processing oil and olives since 1906 in South Eastern Sicily. They also offer a wide variety of jams, herbs, and salts all grown in the same region.

MADE IN: SICILY, ITALY

products.title: Gourmet Italian Capers in Sea Salt - Capers Non Pareil
products.descriptionHtml:
NON-PAREIL - These are the most prized capers because of their firm texture and delicate flavor. Our capers are fresh from Sicaly where the world’s finest capers are grown.

All natural, no preservatives or additives, vegan, Non-GMO; Made with only capers and sea salt. We hand-pick the best Sicilian capers and naturally preserve them in salt using our traditional family recipe. Every jar contains a glimpse of our land, a secret of our tradition not yet revealed. Being a real Sicilian family, we wish to share the most authentic products and recipes of this island.

A DELICIOUS SEASONING OR GARNISH - We suggest to unsalt capers before use (by soaking in water for up to 15 minutes). Add a wounderful unique tang to your sauces, seafood, meat, poultry, pasta or salads. As visually appealing as they are tasty!

HEALTHY SALT SUBSTITUTE FULL OF FLAVOR – Use capers non-pareil in both hot and cold recipes to add a sour-salty Mediterranean flavor.
